name: SanDan Farm
tagline: Link to SanDan Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/SanDanFarm/
description: SanDan Farm is a working farm in Harvest Road, NC. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
